_comment: Human decisions about identity, and nothing else.
Almost nothing belongs here. The register already merges case, accents,
punctuation and word order, and `loose_key` merges spellings that are the
same name under a different convention - Patrik/Patrick, Erica/Erika,
Nandi/Nandy, Marko/Marco. Those are rules and they carry over to every
competitor the archive will ever gain.
What is left is what no rule should decide: a typo (Valentino printed as
Valention), a dropped syllable (Khalilzade/Khalizade), a genuine variant
spelling (Florijanić/Florjanić). Merging those on resemblance would also
merge siblings, and this archive is full of them.
Run `python3 analyse.py names` for the pairs awaiting a decision.
"same": spellings confirmed to be one competitor.
"different": names that look alike and are two people.
